title: Fuzzy Accuracy Compensates for Label Subjectivity in Classification of Skin Tone Using Wearable Photoplethysmography Signals
abstract: arXiv:2608.18969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the problem of classification of skin tone using photoplethysmography (PPG) signals with labels of the ordinal six-class Fitzpatrick skin tones. A typical accuracy for this task is a poor 40-55 %. However, the labels are subjectively determined by comparing the skin with a colour chart, and hence contain widespread small-scale inaccuracies. By working with a "fuzzy accuracy", which deems a prediction of skin tone class to be correct if its difference from the labelled class is not greater than one, much higher accuracy is obtained which provides more convincing evidence that skin tone can be accurately predicted from PPG signals. Three machine learning approaches were used, namely deep learning or tree-based approaches on raw PPG signals, deep learning on image representations of the signals generated by the Symmetric Projection Attractor Reconstruction (SPAR) method, and machine learning on features extracted from the signal

translated_title: 模糊准确率补偿了使用可穿戴光电容积脉搏波信号进行肤色分类中的标签主观性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18969v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们考虑了使用光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号进行肤色分类的问题，标签为有序六类菲茨帕特里克肤色。该任务的典型准确率仅为40-55%。然而，标签是通过将皮肤与颜色图表进行比较而主观确定的，因此包含广泛的小规模不准确性。通过使用“模糊准确率”（即如果预测的肤色类别与标签类别的差异不超过一个等级，则视为正确），可以获得更高的准确率，这提供了更有说服力的证据，表明肤色可以从PPG信号中准确预测。我们使用了三种机器学习方法，即基于原始PPG信号的深度学习或树基方法、对由对称投影吸引子重构（SPAR）方法生成的信号图像表示进行深度学习，以及对从信号中提取的特征进行机器学习。
tldr: 本文提出使用模糊准确率（允许预测类别与标签相差不超过一个等级）来评估PPG信号肤色分类，克服了标签主观性导致的低准确率问题，并验证了三种机器学习方法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a fuzzy accuracy metric that allows predictions within one class of the label, mitigating label subjectivity and demonstrating higher classification performance for skin tone from PPG signals using three machine learning approaches.
